title: Must‑Have UK Airports in MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update | Liverpool, Kemble & Thruxton!
description:
n the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 18, 2026, this week brings some absolute must‑have new UK regional gems including iniBuilds EGGP Liverpool Airport and Burning Blue Design’s detailed EGBP Cotswold Airport (Kemble) now available for PC simmers!

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 NetDesign: CBBC Bella Bella Airport (Beautiful remote Canadian regional airport)
🛫 FlightSim Studio AG: EDWW Warngau Airfield (Charming German GA airfield)
🛫 Burning Blue Design: EGBP Cotswold Airport (Popular UK GA & storage airfield)
🛫 Burning Blue Design: EGTH Old Warden Aerodrome (Historic UK flying site)
🛫 Burning Blue Design: EGLD Denham Airport (Busy London-area airfield)
🛫 Burning Blue Design: EGHO Thruxton Aerodrome (Well-known UK general aviation hub)
🛫 iniBuilds: EGGP Liverpool Airport (Major UK international airport)
🛫 Orbx: F62 Hayfork Airport (Remote California backcountry airstrip)
🛫 South Oak Co: NZWU Whanganui Airport (New Zealand regional airport)
🛫 South Oak Co: WMPA Lumut Airport (Scenic Malaysian airfield)
🛫 WINGSIM: SKRH Airport Almirante Padilla V2 (Colombian coastal airport)
